security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http: https: ws: wss:; media-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: A native desktop HTTP/REST API client
bundle.longDescription: REST In Peace is a desktop HTTP/REST API client for sending requests, inspecting responses, and persisting history and collections locally. It sends requests over the network and talks only to web resources — there is no server component of its own, and everything it stores stays on your machine.
